title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1971-04-27

ai_review.summary: Rare Beach Boys/Dead crossover with a standout Okie from Muskogee, but limited classic jams and unclear recording quality make the overall experience mixed.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the unique Beach Boy collaboration and cite the Okie from Muskogee as a high point, while noting that the beach‑boy set lacks classic Dead jams. No concrete details on the audio source are provided, and one reviewer complained about the unavailability of those songs in the archive, leading to mixed overall sentiment.

ai_rating.rationale: Average star rating (5, 2, 4) yields ~3.7; reviewers are split between high praise for specific moments and criticism of availability and lack of jams, with no technical audio details.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No reviewer mentioned sound clarity, mix, or source type; assessment based on absence of comments.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The show mixes Beach Boy numbers with Dead material; reviewers note the beach‑boy portion lacks classic jams but contains a few peaks.
